title: Endpoint gauges for a conditional kappa = 5.98615e-6 bound
body:
This extends the partial-swap construction at `f2ab41aebad47861caf6316282c1793e5513845e`, retaining its PR #10 ancestry. This round adds one commit. Please merge the preceding contributions first, or review this commit as the incremental change.

Under the retained analytic and fixed-tape interfaces, the new construction gives

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{119723}{20000000000}=5.98615\times10^{-6}.
$$

## Construction

Complementary source and sink gauges remove the middle-stage auxiliary entrance and combine its rank with the exit. The total rank remains `Wm-2N+2L`. For the selected bit dimensions `(32,30,40)`, the merged boundary uses recursive widths `30,38340`. A compatible controlled rational basis supplies the remaining projector profiles.

A quadratic-phase normal form executes every nondegenerate binary residual, including alternating and signed residuals, with one complex child and fourth-root phase wrappers. The new Gaussian-dyadic producer retains all point centers and the global total. Its dimensions are also `(32,30,40)`, with separate counts from the bit producer.

The component savings are

- bit: `2993093/250000000000`, with exact certified moment gap greater than `2.2673e-14`;
- complex: `3/125000`, with exact certified moment gap greater than `7.9298e-9`.

The updated precision guard uses `rho=19/10`, `gamma=9997/10000`, and `C1=1187/625`. All 29 retained strict constraints and seven assembly margins hold. The final absorption gap exceeds `1.6569e-13`.

## Review artifacts

- `artifacts/endpoint-gauge-note.pdf` and `notes/endpoint-gauge-note.tex`: current proof, including the selected basis, endpoint normalization, precision guard and assembly.
- `scripts/endpoint_gauge_producer.py`: reconstruction of the six selected scalar producers, frame assignments and carrier matchings.
- `certificates/endpoint-gauge-network.json`: exact recursive call lists, moments, guard, finite basis checks and assembly.
- `SOURCES.json` and `NOTICE`: parent and archive pins, attribution and licensing.

The result remains conditional on the retained framework. Generic common-basis existence and the analytic/tape interfaces are written arguments, separate from the finite arithmetic checks. The inherited `patches/batched-23.patch` remains the #10 baseline; the new extension is presented in its standalone proof.

The Gaussian scaling correction from #10 is preserved with `P=34p`. Original copyrights and Apache-2.0 notices are retained. This contribution is by icekylinx, developed and integrated with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance.

## Validation

- Rebuilt all six selected scalar producers from source; exact supports, center coefficients, frame checks, carrier counts and every histogram entry passed.
- Reconstructed both recursive call lists and certified the moments, precision guard, 29 strict constraints and seven assembly margins with exact rational arithmetic.
- Both new algebra tests passed, including alternating and signed binary phase residuals.
- Compiled the new standalone proof PDF and passed whitespace checks.

Only new or changed content was verified in this round. Unchanged producer, regression and historical patch checks from the preceding round were not rerun.
